ARTIFACTS.defect: reports/actual-writes.json published nonWhitespaceGlyphsOutsideMeasuredWriteBoxes as a LITERAL 0 that no code path computed (former line 904), and countCompleteness gated the visualDefects counter on that same literal (former line 713), so the counter could not fire however the page looked.
ARTIFACTS.remedy: Both output-byte glyph readings are now measured from the produced PDF by the shared FIX137 module scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-output-glyph-reading.mjs, with placement measured against the pinned source's own widget rectangles. That module returns null -- never 0 -- when no source is supplied, and the counter now treats null as a defect rather than as clean. The narrower reading the builder already took (glyphs at written widget rects only, and appearances read at measured rects) is kept beside them under glyphsAtWrittenWidgetRects and appearancesReadAtMeasuredWidgetRects rather than deleted.
ARTIFACTS.teethAdded: The literal was only half the problem: ink drawn INSIDE a declared write box is invisible to the placement reading by construction, and all 16 boxed rules sat inside one. The builder now also reads what the delivered appearance at each declared-underline written widget STROKES, attributing each path to the operator that paints it. Attribution matters: pdf-lib emits an unpainted four-sided path and a four-sided clip in every text appearance it generates, and a running maximum over the stream reads both as a box -- my first draft of this reader did exactly that and called the repaired page broken. It is fixed and the classification is now correct in both directions.
